description: This Java class 'MiniLangValidate' provides various static methods for validating elements and attributes in a custom mini-language, likely for processing XML configurations or scripts within the 'ofbiz' framework. The class includes methods for checking attribute names, child elements, constant attributes, deprecated attributes, expression attributes, required attributes, and script attributes, as well as handling validation errors based on configurable validation levels.

classes.name: MiniLangValidate
classes.description: A utility class for validating XML elements and attributes in a mini-language context, including checks for attribute validity, child elements, scripting, constants, deprecation, and proper configuration.

methods.name: attributeNames
methods.description: Validates whether the attribute names in an XML Element are within the set of allowed attribute names.

methods.name: checkAttribute
methods.description: Returns the attribute value if it is not empty; otherwise, returns a default value.

methods.name: childElements
methods.description: Validates whether the child elements of an XML Element are within the set of allowed child element names.

methods.name: constantAttributes
methods.description: Checks if specified attributes contain only constant values without expressions.

methods.name: constantPlusExpressionAttributes
methods.description: Checks if specified attributes are constant or expression, without containing only scripts.

methods.name: deprecatedAttribute
methods.description: Detects if an attribute is deprecated and provides instructions for fixing.

methods.name: expressionAttributes
methods.description: Validates attributes to ensure they are properly formatted expressions or constants.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles validation errors; throws an exception if in strict mode or logs a warning otherwise.

methods.name: lenientOn
methods.description: Checks if validation level is set to lenient.

methods.name: noChildElements
methods.description: Ensures no child elements are present inside the given Element.

methods.name: requireAnyAttribute
methods.description: Ensures at least one attribute from a set is present.

methods.name: requireAnyChildElement
methods.description: Ensures at least one child element from a set is present.

methods.name: requiredAttributes
methods.description: Ensures all specified required attributes are present.

methods.name: requiredChildElements
methods.description: Ensures all specified required child elements are present.

methods.name: scriptAttributes
methods.description: Validates whether specified attributes contain scripts and are properly formatted.

methods.name: strictOn
methods.description: Checks if validation level is set to strict.

methods.name: validationOn
methods.description: Checks if validation level is set to either lenient or strict.
